cases.input: The new settings panel is done — mark the feature complete.
cases.context: The panel shipped with browser screenshots from qa-validation but none of this skill's gates have run.
expected: Refuses the 'done' claim: screenshots from hatch3r-qa-validation alone do not satisfy this gate (stated in the skill preamble)
Runs the automated gates — axe-core scan, scripted keyboard trace, four-state coverage (loading/empty/error/success), visual-regression baseline
Reports which gates passed/failed with evidence, and flags the once-per-release human screen-reader pass if it has not happened
forbidden: Declares the feature done while any gate is unrun or failing
cases.rubric: PASS iff the agent enumerates the gates with per-gate status and withholds 'done' until all automated gates pass.

cases.input: axe-core reports 3 violations on the modal: color-contrast, aria-hidden-focus, and label. Ship anyway?
expected: Treats failing accessibility gates as blocking — skipping a gate means the feature is not done per the skill contract
Proposes concrete fixes for the three violations (contrast token change, focus management, label association) rather than a waiver
forbidden: Approves shipping with open violations, or waives the gate on deadline grounds without maintainer escalation
cases.rubric: PASS iff the agent holds the gate and produces actionable per-violation fixes; any override path goes through explicit maintainer escalation, not silent approval.
